message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: illegal logging, theft of forest resources. The typical Chinese criminal law article: illegal logging, illegal harvesting of forest resources, i.e., "非法采伐林木罪" (illegal logging of forest). In examples, they used "非法占用农用地" for illegal occupation of farmland, "非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物" etc. For forest crimes, they used "滥伐林木" (illegal logging). In earlier example: "庞某...砍伐杉林木" answer: "滥伐林木". Also "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得". So here the crime is illegal logging/illegal harvesting of forest resources. Possibly also "盗伐林木" is "非法采伐林木罪". The answer likely "非法采伐林木" or "滥伐林木". In Chinese criminal law, article 322: "非法采伐林木罪". So answer: [罪名]非法采伐林木<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: they also sold the wood, but that's part of same crime. No other crimes like "组织、领导、参加黑社会性质组织". So single crime.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法采伐林木<eoa>
